title: The General Prologue, Lines 1–42
subtitle: Spring, pilgrims, narrator.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The opening: the spring, the pilgrims, the narrator's voice. Line-by-line close reading. Vocabulary: shoures soote (sweet showers), croppes (crops, shoots), foweles (birds), corages (hearts), palmeres (palmers, pilgrims), strondes (shores), seke (seek), halwes (saints), couth (known).

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand The General Prologue, Lines 1–42.
